comment: Footswitch-triggered freeze. Stomp the slot ON and whatever you just played is held indefinitely while the dry keeps passing, so you play over your own sustained chord. Only possible because EdgeWatch proved on hardware that the effect keeps running while bypassed, sees params[0] change from the footswitch, and still receives input audio while bypassed -- so the ring is already full at the moment you stomp and the capture is instantaneous. Sustain is granular rather than looped, because a loop of any length betrays itself as a period.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category, matching the rest of the release pack.
fxid_comment: 0x1B8. Free: unused by stock effects, not a retired custom alias, and clear of the fxid collisions audited on 2026-08-18.

params.name: Length
params.comment: Loop length, ~60 ms .. ~1.4 s, and live. The stomp always captures the full 1.4 s looking BACKWARDS (Stasis records while the slot is off and stops when it is on), and Length chooses how much of that loops, ending at the moment you stomped. Was latched at capture in v1-v2, which made it dead while the hold was running.

params.name: Blur
params.comment: Crossfade at the loop seam, as a FRACTION of the loop (~2%..40%), so it does the same audible thing at any Length. As an absolute sample count its whole sweep moved the crossfade 0.4%..6.5% of the loop at long Lengths -- inaudible.

params.name: Decay
params.comment: How the hold fades. Fully up is genuinely infinite.

params.name: Tone
params.comment: Low-pass on the held layer only; the dry stays open.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Level of the held layer. NOT a dry/wet crossfade -- the dry always passes at unity so you can play over the hold at full strength. As a crossfade this cost 6 dB just for having Stasis in the patch, because the wet side is silent until you stomp.
